summary.name: Sensei
summary.one_liner: Sensei is a Mac system performance toolkit from Cindori that monitors CPU, GPU, temperatures, fans, storage and battery, and includes junk cleanup, app uninstalling, S.M.A.R.T. drive checks and disk benchmarking.
use_cases: Monitor CPU, GPU and temperatures from the menu bar
Free up storage by removing caches, logs and large files
Completely uninstall apps and their leftover files
Check SSD or HDD health with S.M.A.R.T. analysis
Check MacBook battery cycle count and capacity
Benchmark disk read and write speeds
summary.what_it_does: Sensei provides a menu bar system monitor and dashboard that tracks CPU, GPU, storage usage, battery health and temperature sensors and fan speeds in real time, with customizable widgets and themes. It includes a storage scanner that finds system junk, old caches, logs, large downloads and leftover installation files without touching personal data. Its uninstaller claims to remove apps along with their leftover files. Hardware tools include a Drive Health Report using S.M.A.R.T. analysis, a MacBook battery health tool showing cycle count and capacity, a disk speed benchmark for HDDs and SSDs, and an SSD Trim toggle. The page says it supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
notable: Menu bar monitor with customizable widgets, dashboards and themes
S.M.A.R.T. drive health report for HDD and SSD
Enable SSD Trim support with a simple switch
Supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
caveats: Page does not state whether any features require a paid upgrade; the meta description says 'Free download' but the page gives no pricing details.
Trim, S.M.A.R.T. and some hardware sensor features may depend on macOS and hardware support; the page does not detail limits.
